summary: Telix Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K attaching ASX announcements disclosing a signed agreement to merge with private German radioisotope producer ITM Isotope Technologies Munich SE. Upfront consideration is US$1.65 billion on a cash-free/debt-free basis; after adjustments ITM holders are expected to receive roughly US$1.25 billion in Telix shares priced at US$11.841 each, issued as Nasdaq ADRs after escrow periods, plus up to US$700 million contingent on ITM-11 regulatory approvals and commercial sales milestones. The deal requires Telix shareholder approval and customary conditions. Watch escrow-release overhang, milestone probability for ITM-11, and integration of ITM's 177Lu supply chain.
